templateStory.scope.en: Image references stay local and are not opened or uploaded. New image lists allow up to six references per beat.
templateStory.scope.zh-Hans: 图片引用仅保留在本地，不会自动打开或上传。每个节点新编辑的图片列表最多六个引用。

templateStory.historicalImages.en: This historical list has more than six images. It is preserved; you can keep it or remove references.
templateStory.historicalImages.zh-Hans: 此历史列表超过六张图片，已原样保留。你可以保留或移除引用。

templateStory.imageLimit.en: The image change was not saved. Use at most six references, or only remove references from a historical oversized list.
templateStory.imageLimit.zh-Hans: 图片修改未保存。请最多填写六个引用，或仅从超限的历史列表中移除引用。

templateStory.unsupported.en: This story uses an unsupported or malformed format. Its original content is preserved and cannot be edited here.
templateStory.unsupported.zh-Hans: 此剧情格式不受支持或已损坏。原始内容已保留，无法在此编辑。

templateStory.derivedSummary.en: Review summary is derived from timeline text, joined with newlines and limited to 500 UTF-16 units. Full beat text is retained.
templateStory.derivedSummary.zh-Hans: 预览摘要由时间线文本以换行拼接生成，最多500个UTF-16单位。节点全文仍会保留。

templateStory.summaryBoundary.en: The summary cutoff splits a Unicode character that Swift cannot preserve exactly. Full text is kept in the draft; adjust text near the 500 UTF-16-unit boundary before preparing a request.
templateStory.summaryBoundary.zh-Hans: 摘要截断点拆分了Swift无法完整保留的Unicode字符。全文仍保留在草稿中；请调整500个UTF-16单位附近的文本后再准备请求。
